resources.basis: Prior full313MB SQLite evidence read/join129MB resident; output is deduplicated occurrence dataset and references, not proof copy. All raw corpus/annotation assets reused. Prospective output ceiling checked before each write.

split.formula: first16hex SHA256(canonical JSON [salt,component]) modulo5==0 test; remaining train; exposure component override development

eligibility.source: single exact native token, lowercase, complete noun form; existing inherited source-name exception only; number agreement
eligibility.target: complete supported noun form; original target guards never lifted
eligibility.roles: both exact complete forms NOUN; existing annotation only
eligibility.alignment: original envelope reasons and exact focus reasons must both be empty; all compound/mask/mutual/crossing reasons retained
eligibility.direct: Separate experimental unresolved native-gloss evidence only, source_entry_resolved false/source_sense_id null, all surviving form candidates retained; no shared term fabricated
eligibility.nonexplicit_old_links: Excluded, counted separately as raw evidence

estimator.key: normalized actual source spelling + noun + dictionary number
estimator.prediction_class: exact emitted target face, preserve every distinct form/lexeme/reading/proof as supporting alternatives; no sense identity conflation in records
estimator.dedup: one pool/source endpoint+exact UTF16 focus/key; merge repeated heads/forms/translations into target set
estimator.weights: For each key each component total mass1 split equally across its deduplicated source-focus occurrences, then equally across conflicting observed target faces
estimator.features: binary normalized alphabetic token and unambiguous existing contextual lemma; exclude source focus; local signed offset +/-2 native tokens, sentence bag covers full source sentence. No target context or test vocabulary
estimator.vocabulary: per source key, feature occurs in >=2 distinct TRAIN components
estimator.likelihood: add-one multinomial smoothing, log prior + sum log likelihood of retained feature presence
estimator.fallback: no training key => null; no retained features => default; ties score then prior then lexicographic exact face
estimator.candidate_set: TRAIN faces for source spelling/number only, never restrict to held-out reference

metrics.reference: any retained supported target face of held-out source occurrence, a surrogate not semantic gold
required: paired gains/losses and same-face zero immersion

review.option_blinding: distinct faces sorted SHA256 [blind-option-r01,sourcefocus ID,face], no method names; separate method-key withheld
review.full_context: complete original corpus message and single-focus mixed outputs; all train competing targets, full paired witnesses and proof IDs retained; no prior chat available

implementation_limit: Reproducible Python multinomial estimator inspired by contextual frequency/weighted-feature lexical selection; not claiming to execute Apertium lex-tools ML/ME or learn human-approved semantics. No new annotation, downloads, selector projection or activation.
